No images, no network: every // pixel is an SVG element built here. const SVG_NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'; const VIEW_W = 520; const VIEW_H = 360; // Build one SVG element from a spec, for one side ('left' | 'right'). // A spec whose attrs carry only:'left'/'right' draws on that side alone. // A spec whose attrs carry diff + alt draws its alt form on the right. function svgEl(spec, side) { const a = spec.a || {}; if (a.only && a.only !== side) return null; if (side === 'right' && a.diff && a.alt) { return svgEl(a.alt, side); } const el = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, spec.t); for (const key of Object.keys(a)) { if (key === 'diff' || key === 'alt' || key === 'only') continue; el.setAttribute(key, a[key]); } if (spec.text !== undefined) el.textContent = spec.text; for (const child of spec.c || []) { const built = svgEl(child, side); if (built) el.appendChild(built); } return el; } // The base picture only (no markers): reused by the magnifier lens. function buildBaseSVG(scene, side) { const svg = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'svg'); svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + VIEW_W + ' ' + VIEW_H); svg.setAttribute('width', '100%'); svg.setAttribute('height', '100%'); svg.setAttribute('role', 'img'); svg.setAttribute('aria-label', scene.name + ' picture, ' + side + ' side'); const defs = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'defs'); const grad = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'linearGradient'); grad.setAttribute('id', 'sky'); grad.setAttribute('x1', '0'); grad.setAttribute('y1', '0'); grad.setAttribute('x2', '0'); grad.setAttribute('y2', '1'); const stop1 = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'stop'); stop1.setAttribute('offset', '0'); stop1.setAttribute('stop-color', scene.sky[0]); const stop2 = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'stop'); stop2.setAttribute('offset', '1'); stop2.setAttribute('stop-color', scene.sky[1]); grad.appendChild(stop1); grad.appendChild(stop2); defs.appendChild(grad); svg.appendChild(defs); for (const spec of scene.elements) { const built = svgEl(spec, side); if (built) svg.appendChild(built); } return svg; } // A full panel: base picture plus overlay groups the game draws into. function buildPanel(scene, side) { const svg = buildBaseSVG(scene, side); const markers = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'g'); markers.setAttribute('class', 'markers'); const hints = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'g'); hints.setAttribute('class', 'hints'); const cursor = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'g'); cursor.setAttribute('class', 'cursor'); svg.appendChild(hints); svg.appendChild(markers); svg.appendChild(cursor); return { svg: svg, markers: markers, hints: hints, cursor: cursor }; } // A satisfying found mark: a green ring that pulses once, plus the find's number. function addFoundMark(markers, x, y, n) { const g = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'g'); g.setAttribute('class', 'found-mark'); const ring = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'circle'); ring.setAttribute('cx', x); ring.setAttribute('cy', y); ring.setAttribute('r', 20); ring.setAttribute('class', 'found-ring'); const badge = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'circle'); badge.setAttribute('cx', x + 16); badge.setAttribute('cy', y - 16); badge.setAttribute('r', 10); badge.setAttribute('class', 'found-badge'); const label = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'text'); label.setAttribute('x', x + 16); label.setAttribute('y', y - 12.5); label.setAttribute('class', 'found-label'); label.textContent = String(n); g.appendChild(ring); g.appendChild(badge); g.appendChild(label); markers.appendChild(g); } // A wrong click: a red X that fades away. function addMissMark(markers, x, y) { const g = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'g'); g.setAttribute('class', 'miss-mark'); const l1 = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'line'); l1.setAttribute('x1', x - 9); l1.setAttribute('y1', y - 9); l1.setAttribute('x2', x + 9); l1.setAttribute('y2', y + 9); const l2 = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, 'line'); l2.setAttribute('x1', x - 9);
